_comment: Benson group additivity for ideal-gas organic molecules at 298.15 K (src/benson.rs). Each group: [dfH kcal/mol, S cal/(mol K)] with S the intrinsic group entropy (the symmetry term -R ln sigma is applied per molecule; the C-(H)4 row is methane itself). Values are recalled from Benson, Thermochemical Kinetics, 2nd ed. (1976) and Cohen & Benson, Chem. Rev. 93 (1993) 2419; the alkane, alkene, alkyne, benzene, alcohol, ether, ketone, aldehyde, acid and amine rows are the published ones, while CO-(CB)(C), CB-(CO), CB-(N), O-(CB)(C), the C-(N)(...) and C-(CO)(...) rows were recalled less certainly (acetophenone and aniline back-calculation) and carry no gate of their own. tests/open_items_b.rs compares 39 molecules with the experimental gas-phase dfH and S. Tier of everything derived: Estimated. A molecule with an atom no group covers gets no Benson estimate (the caller falls back to Joback)

gauche._comment: Alkane gauche correction per gauche interaction between carbon substituents of two sp3 carbons in the lowest-energy staggered conformer, kcal/mol.

ring_corrections._comment: Ring strain corrections [dfH kcal/mol, S cal/(mol K)] keyed by ring size, kind (carbocycle, one C=C in the ring, O in the ring). Benzene-type aromatic rings carry none. The sigma of a bare cycloalkane is tabulated here because the planar-average symmetry of the small rings and the D3d chair of cyclohexane are not what the graph automorphism count gives.
